scope: Yom Kippur 5761 The Origins of Awareness provenance audit; 2015 Temple manuscript and 2013 audio bounded negative checks

manuscript.title: The Origins of Awareness
manuscript.author_attribution: Rabbi Samuel M. Cohon (PDF-internal named sermon author)
manuscript.attribution_basis: PDF opening identifies a winter 2001 Temple class co-taught with Rabbi Samuel Cohon, then states it reproduces a Yom Kippur sermon by him; PDF page 8 supplies matching title, holiday, rabbi name and Temple Emanu-El/Tucson attribution; page 14 concludes with a blessing.

additional_textual_representation.observed_evidence: Scribd visible text reproduces the same document introduction, syllabus, 2000 sermon heading/opening, and ending.
additional_textual_representation.independence_assessment: Not independently authenticated: the Scribd and Avalon text could be descendants of one identical source and do not establish author's final wording or publication permission.

additional_listed_mirror.observed_evidence: Search listing mirrors document beginning; direct PDF open yielded a cache miss.
additional_listed_mirror.independence_assessment: No independent document text or binary identity verification beyond search listing.

external_affiliation_context.observed_evidence: Current institutional professional page confirms Stuart Hameroff's University of Arizona affiliation and consciousness research.
external_affiliation_context.note: Do not present this generic biography as evidence that the university currently hosts or authorized the Cohon sermon.

historical_academic_source.status: legacy path associated with source by public search-index label; modern arizona.edu and archive.consciousness.arizona.edu equivalents could not be accessed directly

reproduction_listing.observed_evidence: Third-party archive index lists the mirrored PDF, circa 445 KB, with 2018-05-31 listing modification; index timestamp is the mirror's metadata and not evidence of original sermon creation or author approval.

manuscript.assessment: Attributed substantial public reproduction corroborated across mirror/index and secondary transcription. Authenticity of Temple manuscript or author-final text NOT established. Do not claim original recovered.

refugee_sermon_2015.latest_access: not accessible in current web reader using HTTP, HTTPS or alternative domain
refugee_sermon_2015.archive_snapshot_search_result: No authenticated manuscript snapshot located with search queries; archive.org replay access unavailable. Not an archive-wide negative.

early_2013_audio.research_note: 2013 podcast advertised in first-party newsletter, but no stable episode URL or 2013 audio file discovered in bounded public searches.
